description: Thanks to everyone who attended the Salt Lake County Convention last Saturday. I especially want to thank Sue Schulman who helped us secure the location for this event. It was a successful convention, and it was wonderful to meet the other Salt Lake County Candidates that I will be serving with in the next term.
